=== opcult theme parent? ===
profile/themes/opcult_starterkit/opcult_starterkit.info.yml
profile/themes/opcult/opcult.info.yml
--- opcult info ---
name: 'OpenCulturas Next'
type: theme
core_version_requirement: ^11

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== lifecycle / core marker for the 4 modules ==="; for m in openculturas_discussions openculturas_faq openculturas_section; do echo "--- $m ---"; grep -iE "lifecycle|core|lifecycle_link|type:" profile/modules/custom/$m/$m.info.yml 2>/dev/null; done; echo "=== opcult theme parent? ==="; find web/profiles profile -path "*opcult*" -name "*.info.yml" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- opcult info ---"; f=$(find web/profiles profile -path "*opcult/opcult*" -name "opcult.info.yml" 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] && grep -iE "type:|core_version|name:|base:" "$f" | head
